title: First Frost (8 AM)
subtitle: 8 AM · Crisp frost on the glass
blurb: Frosty morning light on the windowpane — warm felt piano, icicle music-box bells, and a gentle sleepy boom-bap pulse.

title: Steam on the Glass (11 AM)
subtitle: 11 AM · Warm café pour-over
blurb: Steaming pour-over coffee in a quiet wooden café — mellow Rhodes voicings, singing felt piano, and a head-nod lo-fi pocket.

title: Tram Through White Pines (2 PM)
subtitle: 2 PM · Snowy commuter tram
blurb: Vintage cream-and-green tram gliding past snow-laden pines — rolling 84 BPM lo-fi drums, deep sub-bass, and bright rail bells.

title: Kettle & Snowfall (5 PM)
subtitle: 5 PM · Glowing café twilight
blurb: The album's centerpiece at cobalt twilight — copper kettle steam, warm amber window glow, lyrical felt piano, and falling snow.

title: Wool & Hearthlight (9 PM)
subtitle: 9 PM · Deep amber hearthlight
blurb: Quiet evening wrapped in wool by the fire — smoky C-minor Rhodes 9ths, intimate fireside piano, and slow 72 BPM boom-bap.

title: Midnight Snowfall (12 AM)
subtitle: 12 AM · Quiet midnight snowfall
blurb: Empty snow-dusted streetlamps at midnight — delicate music-box lullaby, pillowy 68 BPM brushes, and a drifting starlight pad.
